Moongate was developed based on scientific studies which demonstrate that listening to binaural beats can influence brainwave patterns to encourage specific mental states. Low frequency brainwaves correspond to sleep, relaxation, and meditation while high frequency brainwaves occur during periods of focus, learning, and problem solving. What are Binaural Beats?
Binaural beats are an auditory phenomenon perceived by the brain when two slightly different frequencies are played separately in each ear. The difference between these two tones causes the listener to perceive a third distinct tone called the “binaural beat”.
